title: dasiphora parvifolia
intro: Dasiphora parvifolia, commonly known as Russian wormwood or Davisia, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dasiphora parvifolia include its ability to reduce pain and fever, as well as its antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
